package_ownership_policy: Every CSV row has a physical board owner in each option; all fitted loads use EXT load-side or existing derived rails, local AGND/paired-rail returns and dedicated main feeds. DNP rows retain geometry but zero fitted injection. No independent source or signal normal is added.
status: SOURCE CONTRACT READY FOR REVIEW; architecture NOT SELECTED; native/physical acceptance NOT RUN

source_return_topology.topology: Single EXT source common return bonded to instrument AGND star at inlet. Separate return conductors for rail branches join the star. All 180 patch sleeves are AGND, so patching creates parallel return paths.
source_return_topology.reference: OCTAVE_REF and all O1..O5 remain EXT; no cross-domain reference supply. Buffered taps may cross boards only within EXT and OSC-ES-1 limits.
source_return_topology.earth: Require isolated SELV external supply output with documented chassis/earth bonding; connected equipment may create an earth loop. Do not float patch sleeves or use them as sole power return.
source_return_topology.sensitive_nodes: Hold, timing, summing, integrator and slew storage nodes stay local; no additional signal normals.

existing_EL_bounds.EL_basis: Six OPA4196 quads: 6 mA Iq per analog rail; 12 stage LED hard bounds 4.63 mA each; 4.7uF/rail 10ms ramp and margin. 12 base paths each conservatively 26.4V/(10kohm*0.99)=2.667mA plus6mA Iq and7.445mA bulk ramp, below50mA/analog rail; +5V 55.56mA LEDs +0.667mA pullups +3.102mA bulk ramp below70mA. Stage resistor/reference draw included by 50/50/70 mA ceilings; measured dynamic/fault bound NOT RUN. Six parallel rail paths and twelve ground paths use maximum-path conductance, no equal-current assertion.

return_and_fault_contract.partial_power: Any missing/late rail or unplugged satellite can be backfed by signal/reference pins; common EXT is not sequencing protection. Require load-side detection, bounded injection, all-rail shutdown/discharge and reverse blocking (#59).
return_and_fault_contract.return_open: GH returns and patch sleeves can become unintended supply returns after a main return opens. No live internal service, ground switching or equal-sharing assumption. Return integrity and fault energy remain OPEN.
return_and_fault_contract.reference: O1-O5/OCTAVE_REF stay KA; existing adjacent Kelvin AGND and <=300mm/<=1nF reference harness conditions remain. Local sense does not cancel remote drop.
return_and_fault_contract.coupling: All cores, front boards, dedicated feeds and GH returns form one coupled network; old K nominal/return proofs are epoch-specific and cannot qualify this comparison.
